name: GSAP 3.13+ formerly-Club plugins (SplitText, DrawSVG, MorphSVG)

licensing.notes: The workspace gsap-plugins skill states all plugins are free since the Webflow acquisition. The licence text for the exact version has not been reviewed in this workspace.

rendering_constraints.notes: Requires upgrading from the approved GSAP 3.12.5 to >= 3.13; existing projects pin 3.12.5 and must keep working.

justification: Proposed, not adopted. The studio runtime (src/studio) already covers split text, stroke drawing and morphs between compatible paths with GSAP 3.12.5 core. Adopt only for arbitrary-shape morphs (MorphSVG) after licence review and an M2 benchmark.
